gen.title: Sorting with divide and conquer review

cards.stem: Which variant is listed as a specialization of this sorting method?
cards.quote: Specialization (... is a kind of me.) k-way merge sort, balanced k-way merge sort, polyphase merge sort.

cards.stem: Which approach is listed as an aggregate child used in this method?
cards.quote: Aggregate child (... is a part of or used in me.) divide and conquer.

cards.stem: How does the definition describe the first step of this sort?
options: splits the items to be sorted into two groups
cards.quote: A sort algorithm that splits the items to be sorted into two groups, recursively sorts each group, and merges them into a final, sorted sequence.
